batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: CX PR 3c, the Account settings layout with sub-tabs
kind: Reports to docs/revamp/specs/customer-experience.md (pages table, Account row). The long Account column becomes sub-tabs Profile, Workspaces and Team, Notifications, Plan and Billing and Security. The tools and entry points it repeated now live only in All tools.
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. No route, table, migration, switch, provider, payment or write is added. No request, command id or payload changes.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main aca2f368 (PR 319, CX PR 3b). CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
newFiles: apps/web/app/account/account-settings.tsx (AccountSettings): the five tabs on the shared sub-tabs, a tab only when its area is on, kept by ?tab=
docs/design-system/evidence/revamp-cx3c (the five customer pages at 390 and 1440)
changedFiles: apps/web/app/account/page.tsx: the Account view is built from AccountSettings; the Manage your work links move from the Requests Workspaces tab to the Account Workspaces and Team tab, with the Delegation registrations link left on Requests

apps/web/lib/all-tools.ts: two entries added, Accept a team invitation (/operator/setup) and Open your local helper tasks (/contributor), so everything the Account page used to repeat is reachable from All tools
tests/e2e/verification/revamp-s2/customer-page-length.spec.ts: Reports and Account are now held to the page length limit, not only reported

decisions.startPage: The Account page's Start page link is not added to All tools again: All tools already lists Open the start page, Plan a mission and Check a request receipt.
decisions.tabLabels: Tab labels use Title Case, as the other tab sets do.
decisions.tests: No existing test changed. The source-string tests that look for the Manage your work label and the Delegation registrations link still find them in the same page file.

receipts.integration: revamp-cx3c-account.test.ts written first: 5 failed, then 5 passed with the build; all-tools, work screen, work items and front door: 124 passed.
receipts.verification: Account measured 1.58 screens at 390 and 1.18 at 1440 before; 1.0 and 1.0 after on a production build, and all five customer pages are within target. Shell, home and account-settings specs: 47 passed.

notRun: The Notifications and Plan and Billing tabs with their switches on: the verification seed has both areas off, so the tabs are covered by the component test.
sensitive: No. Navigation and layout only; every link keeps its own access check.
